label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: The saved eligibility explicitly permits histologically verified relapsed or refractory DSRCT. This is disease-scope compatibility only.
cohort_reconciliation: Phase 2 Part B2 is the DSRCT cohort. Until Phase 1 dose confirmation, its stated age range is 12–39; after confirmation it is 2–39. Title references osteosarcoma and the phase enum is PHASE2, while the detailed record describes phase-dependent WT/DSRCT cohorts. Neither the title nor phase enum resolves which cohorts or ages are currently open.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No positive HER2-expression threshold is stated as a required inclusion criterion in the complete saved eligibility. HER2 IHC prediction of response is an exploratory objective; do not infer a biomarker gate from the drug mechanism. Prior HER2-targeted therapy is excluded.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and active cohort availability are unverified. Relapsed/refractory status, prior treatment, measurable disease, surgical plans and all other clinical criteria still apply. Metadata age limits do not resolve the conditional age expansion.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: DSRCT is explicitly included by tissue diagnosis in the saved eligibility and consistently named in the description. B7-H3 expression is a separate required gate, not established by diagnosis alone.
cohort_reconciliation: Single phase 1 CAR-T treatment cohort for patients aged 1–24 with relapsed or refractory RMS, ES or DSRCT; description, eligibility and arm agree. Separate infusion exclusions apply after initial enrollment assessment.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Tumor expression of B7-H3 is explicitly required; the saved inclusion list does not state an assay cutoff and no patient expression result is available.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol, biomarker assay threshold, manufacturing feasibility and live slots are not independently verified. Measurable cross-sectional disease is required and marrow-only detectable disease is expressly excluded. Other clinical and infusion criteria remain unassessed for an individual.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: DSRCT is explicitly listed for Parts A and B (Phase 1), but not for the NF-associated MPNST-only Part C (Phase 2). The compatibility label is restricted to the saved Phase 1 scope.
cohort_reconciliation: Eligibility lists DSRCT in Phase 1 Parts A/B and restricts Phase 2 Part C to progressive, relapsed, unresectable or metastatic NF-associated MPNST. Description and arms support this distinction. The PHASE2 design enum and overall RECRUITING status do not establish that the DSRCT-compatible Phase 1 parts are currently available.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular inclusion gate is stated for DSRCT in Parts A/B. The NF-associated MPNST requirement belongs to Part C and is not transferred to DSRCT.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and active part/cohort are unverified. Patients must have disease refractory to/progressing after standard therapies, or no standard care options, plus all other clinical criteria. Overall registry status cannot establish live Phase 1 availability.
